newsitem.title: USA: Dickson, Brooks to open Asia stores. [CORRECTED 15:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Dickson, Brooks to open Asia stores. [CORRECTED 15:50 GMT]

text.p: Marks and Spencer Plc's Brooks Brothers said Wednesday it agreed with Dickson Concepts (International) Ltd of Hong Kong to open and operate at least 20 Brooks Brothers franchise stores in Southeast Asia during the next 2 years (corrects from 20 years).
The company said the plan is to open its first stores in Hong Kong in 1998.
Financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
The 10-year agreement gives Dickson the exclusive right to operate stores under the Brooks Brothers name and provides access to Brooks Brothers' marketing and advertising materials.
The company said the agreement covers most countries in Southeast Asia but excludes Japan and South Korea.
Dickson Concepts owns Harvey Nichols in London, S.T. Dupont in Paris and the Seibu stores in Hong Kong and Shenzen.
